a11y.note: The picture of the road itself does not change size. The words around it do.
menu.time.howReal: Matches the time where you are.
menu.title: Menu
postcard.failed: The postcard would not come out. Try again?
postcard.message.label: A few words (up to {max} characters)
postcard.title: Postcard
quiet.explain: Quiet mode keeps things calm: no sound effects, softer music, fewer notices and falling leaves, and fewer road events. Everything you find is still kept in your journal.
rest.body: You've been walking for about {minutes} minutes. This might be a good place to stretch, drink some water, or look at something far away.
rest.late: It's getting late where you are. The road will be here tomorrow.
rest.title: A moment to rest?
share.camp.byHand: Your camp link (press and hold to copy it)
share.camp.text: Come and sit by my fire.
share.camp.title: {name}'s camp
share.privacy: Nothing leaves this device unless you send it. A camp link holds your traveler's name, coat, hat, lantern, your companion, and what is around your fire. Nothing else.
share.visit.invalid: That does not look like a camp link.
share.visit.label: Visit a friend's camp
share.visited.one: You have sat by 1 friend's fire.
share.visited.other: You have sat by {n} friends' fires.
summary.close.companion: {companion} is curling up by the fire. Rest well, both of you.
summary.close.default: A good stretch of road. See you when you're ready.
summary.close.ended: The lamp is lit, and the road is still open. Rest well.
summary.close.many: A day of noticing. That is the whole trick of the road.
summary.close.night: A good time to sleep. The stars will keep your place.
summary.close.none: Not every walk has to find something. The road was glad of the company.
summary.close.still: Sometimes the best walk is a pause. The road will wait.
summary.found.ended: You reached the end of the story.
summary.found.memories.one: The road made a new memory with you.
summary.found.memories.other: The road made {n} new memories with you.
summary.lead: {name}, here is what the last {duration} held.
summary.saved: Your road is saved. Closing this tab is a lovely way to rest.
summary.title: Your walk, so far
visit.alone: A quiet fire, and room for company.
visit.bad: That camp link could not be read.
visit.invite.aria: An invitation to a friend's camp
visit.invite.body: Nothing is asked of you. You can look around, sit for a while, and leave whenever you like.
visit.invite.title: {name} has asked you to sit by their fire
visit.sitText: You sit by {name}'s fire for a while. Neither of you says much. It is a very good conversation.
visit.title: {name}'s camp
visit.with: {companion} the {species} is resting by the fire.
welcome.companion: {companion} has been waiting by the fire.
welcome.gift.one: The road left you {n} token, just for coming back.
welcome.gift.other: The road left you {n} tokens, just for coming back.
welcome.lead: It's been {away}. The road kept your place.
welcome.nothing: There's no schedule here. Nothing was missed.
welcome.season: The season has turned. It's {season} on the road now.
welcome.title: Welcome back, {name}
